name: Stadia button icons
author: Henning Berge and Lynder063
description: The game's PlayStation 2 button icons as a Stadia controller's, from the real Stadia button art: A, B, X and Y for Cross, Circle, Square and Triangle, Stadia's L1, R1, L2 and R2, and its sticks for L3 and R3. Everywhere the game prints a button: help, menus, the vendor. Sharper on a port that draws sharp cells. For Ratchet & Clank and Going Commando. A fork of xbox-icons.

conflicts.reason: both paint the game's button icons

settings.name: Trace
settings.description: For bug reports: a line in the game's log each time the fonts are painted, or found not to be the game's.
